name: Lao Chai
summary: Valley village on the way to Ta Van: walk the terraces and roofs on the 3–5 hour trail from town. The older route runs through Ý Linh Hồ, then Lao Chai, then Ta Van. Xã Lao Chải stayed its own commune in the 2025 merger. The Lao Chải–Tả Van gate is 75,000 đồng for an adult and 50,000 đồng for a child. Read the booth.
getThere: On the valley road toward Ta Van.
heroCaption: Houses and terraces on the slope at Lao Chai
body: Lao Chai is the village on the older route from town through Ý Linh Hồ to Tả Van. The houses and the terraces sit on the slope, with the ridge behind them. You walk through on the way to Ta Van. The stretch that includes both villages is 8–12 km and takes 3–5 hours.

Xã Lao Chải was one of the communes the 2025 resolution left unmerged, so it is still its own commune beside xã Tả Van. The Lao Chải–Tả Van gate is 75,000 đồng for an adult and 50,000 đồng for a child. Read the figure on the gate.

gettingThere: Follow the valley road from town through Ý Linh Hồ to Lao Chai and on to Ta Van. The walk that covers Lao Chai and Ta Van is 8–12 km and takes 3–5 hours.

admissionNote: Lao Chải–Tả Van is 75,000 đồng for an adult and 50,000 đồng for a child. Read the gate.
